features.scope: Native Kotlin, official Compose Material 3, Material You, four primary destinations, responsive navigation, named accessible controls
limits: No pixel-identical clone of the old app
Dynamic/system theme results are tied to the tested image and palette, not all devices

features.scope: Multiple books, shared local accounts, two-level per-book categories, archive/restore, ordering, account groups and aliases
limits: Historical financial and batch-snapshot references prevent incompatible currency/type changes
Restoring a parent category does not silently restore its children

features.scope: Exact minor-unit amounts, unified validated posting transactions, idempotency, revisions, editing, soft delete, single-use undo, list search and filters
limits: No binary floating-point money truth
Failed writes never count as committed transactions

features.scope: Manual editor, raw input recovery, explicit time provenance, tags/notes/exclusion flags, private image attachments and image viewer
limits: Unknown transaction time requires confirmation
Private orphan images are retained until reference-safe cleanup is implemented
Image formats PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF; 20 MiB attachment limit

features.scope: Linked partial and excess refunds, reimbursement advances/settlements, borrow/lend/repay/collect, separate interest, credit payments and cycle settings
limits: Source deletion cannot orphan linked children
Principal and settlements are not duplicate ordinary spending/income
Credit cycles are local records, not bank connectivity

features.scope: Manual exchange rates, actual source/target amounts, independent fees, immutable trade snapshots, asset history and explicit missing-rate states
limits: No live rate service
Changing current valuation rates does not rewrite recorded trade amounts

features.scope: Monthly/annual and category budgets, copy/delete tombstones, daily availability, income/expense/transfer reports, categories, trends, calendar, yearly summary and filters
limits: Statistics and budget exclusions are separate
Refunds can make a period's net spending negative
Charts expose exact textual values; display ratios are not money truth

features.scope: Recurring plans, exact installment division, anchored local calendar/timezone, pending or explicitly automatic posting, catch-up, pause/resume, execution records and duplicate protection
limits: WorkManager is not an exact alarm or a guarantee of manufacturer background execution
Calendar and installment principal cannot rewrite already generated occurrences

features.scope: Fixed, increasing, decreasing and custom savings targets, deposit records, linked real transfers, progress/calendar, editing, sorting and pause
limits: Manual progress records do not secretly create ledger money movements
Deleted or changed linked transfers are flagged rather than counted silently

features.scope: Explicit accessibility consent, enabled-package filtering, bounded node snapshots, event coalescing, 56 modeled payment scenarios and currency/time/evidence validation
limits: 56 synthetic positive/negative pairs do not establish live external-app coverage
No automatic payment clicks or security bypass

features.scope: Deduplication and similarity comparison, account matching, editable queued drafts, floating confirmation, explicit save/ignore/reopen and durable failure history
limits: New drafts queue instead of replacing user input
Recognition counts are not committed-bill counts
Privacy mode suppresses financial overlays

features.scope: Explicit image share/picker import, bundled Chinese OCR, rotation and image limits, known screenshot templates, editable unknowns, cancellable batch review and no-op enhancement contract
limits: No generative AI provider or model download
No broad real-receipt accuracy claim
ML Kit is separately licensed and not claimed to contain no telemetry-related code

features.scope: Complete validated ZIP backup of business tables, original import fields and referenced images, persistent preview, explicit merge/replacement, integrity checks and before-replacement recovery
limits: Unencrypted user-initiated archives
Conflicting IDs block merge rather than silently choosing a winner
One private recovery snapshot; local privacy preferences excluded

features.scope: Bounded mature CSV/XLSX parsing, structured JSON, parsed/raw previews, explicit mappings/selection, row errors, formula-safe exports, exact readback, persistent duplicate receipts and atomic reversible batch operations
limits: 10000 rows, 64 columns and documented byte limits
Original server-provided import platforms are unverified
Qianji mapping has modeled four-basic-kind samples only
Two disclosed UI minors for maximum selection and mapping order

features.scope: System/light/dark appearance, dynamic color control, system-credential privacy lock, secure screenshots, cold-start/background relock, validated quick entries and configurable standard widgets
limits: Standard Android widgets only, not vendor proprietary formats
Widget privacy hides both book name and money even while the app itself is unlocked
No biometric hardware or physical-vendor compatibility claim

features.scope: Independent installable signed release, permission/debug-entry guards, compiled backup-rule checks, SHA-256 and signer readback, dependency license/source notices
limits: Final acceptance status governs whether this release can be called verified
Not a public app-store compliance certification
Release private key is not included in APK/source delivery
